text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed on /v1/generate-prod starting ~10:04 UTC. Possible model runtime crashes (OOM/segfault). Incident ref: INC-2026-0421B. Paging: @maria (oncall).

maria (Oncall Eng): I'm on. Grafana - 5xx jumped from 0.5% -> 11% in 6m. p95 latency spiked to ~600ms. Checking pods...

priya (ML Eng): I see repeated kernel crashes on gpu-node-7 and gpu-node-9. Sample from journalctl:
```
Apr 21 10:05:12 gpu-node-7 model-runner[4721]: runtime error: segfault (read) at 0x0
Apr 21 10:05:12 gpu-node-7 model-runner[4721]: trace: infer_step+0x1a2
Apr 21 10:05:12 gpu-node-7 model-runner[4721]: trace: kv_cache_update+0x4f
```
Correlates with long sequences and batched requests.

osh (SRE): Any recent runtime pushes? release-bot: runtime:v1.20.0 pushed to prod 09:58 UTC.

maria (Oncall Eng): Crashes start ~10:04. Suspect v1.20.0 regression. Initiating emergency rollback and mitigations.

infra-bot: Rollback initiated by @maria: `infra rollback runtime v1.19.9 --env=prod` (job id: rb-8821).

priya (ML Eng): Initial triage: crash happens when allocator path uses new GPU pooling optimization. The `kv_cache->buckets` pointer occasionally null after a failed GPU allocation on OOM. Need guard checks in that codepath.

maria (Oncall Eng): Short-term mitigations applied:
- throttle max_batch_size from 64 -> 12 at the gateway
- reduce max_sequence from 4096 -> 1536 for hosted traffic
- route enterprise traffic to dedicated reserved pools in us-west-2
- enable model fallback to `rw-compat-small` for long requests (>2000 tokens)

osh (SRE): Executing traffic policy changes: `router update /v1/generate-prod --gateway-limits batch=12,seq=1536` and `router shift --to dedicated:0.5`

sam (Support): Customers reporting timeouts and partial generations. Top affected: finlytics, travelmate. Drafting support template. Will share ticket IDs.

priya (ML Eng): Dumped cores uploaded to s3://incidents/1952230001/cores/. One sample shows null deref in `kv_cache_lookup` after `cudaMalloc` returns error but caller ignores and proceeds.

maria (Oncall Eng): Additional quick wins: disable the new pooling via env `MODEL_RUNTIME_DISABLE_GPU_POOL=1` on runners in prod. Applying now as config patch to hosted pools.

infra-bot: Patch applied to hosted-runner group: set MODEL_RUNTIME_DISABLE_GPU_POOL=1 (deployment rolling).

maria (Oncall Eng): After rollback start + env patch + gateway limits, 5xx down from 11% -> 4.2% in ~7m. p95 down to ~240ms. Still not fully baseline.

os h (SRE): (typo corrected) I'm taking over primary oncall from Maria. Items: follow rollback progress, confirm no stale v1.20.0 images in eu regions, continue core analysis with Priya, coordinate customer comms.

tessa (Product): Preparing status page update: "We're investigating elevated errors on generation endpoints; mitigation underway. We'll update every 20 minutes." Need confirmation of affected regions and start time.

sam (Support): Pushing interim note to affected customer accounts: "We're aware of errors on generation endpoints starting ~10:04 UTC; we're rolling back a runtime deploy and applying mitigations. We'll update shortly."

priya (ML Eng): Quick reproducible case: batch_size=48 + seq_len=3072 triggers immediate OOM on v1.20.0 with the new allocator. Reproducer and logs in the ticket. Proposed code fix: check `cudaMalloc` return and skip kv cache update on failure, plus fall back to CPU allocation path.

osh (SRE): Rollback to v1.19.9 completed in us-east-1 and us-west-2 at 10:18 UTC. eu-west-1 still pending (image pull timeout).

maria (Oncall Eng): For eu-west-1, running `infra redeploy runtime v1.19.9 --region eu-west-1 --force` now.

infra-bot: Redeploy queued: job rd-9921 for eu-west-1.

priya (ML Eng): Note: some long-running containers on dedicated pools kept the v1.20.0 image — draining them will help.

os h (SRE): Draining affected nodes and forcing restart of runners on dedicated pools. `k8s cordon/evict` in progress.

maria (Oncall Eng): Hands-off for 20m (break). @osh you're primary. Checklist for osh:
- confirm rollback in all regions
- verify env var patch applied everywhere
- keep status page updates every 20m
- triage cores with Priya and attach repro to postmortem
- coordinate with Support on customer offsets/credits

os h (SRE): Ack. I'll post updates here.

10:26 UTC osh (SRE): Post-rollback metrics: global 5xx at 0.9% now. eu-west-1 saw two residual crashes while redeploy completed; those have stopped after forced restart.

priya (ML Eng): Root-cause hypothesis: new GPU pooling allocator in v1.20.0 didn't handle partial allocation failures during heavy fragmentation; leads to null pointer usage in KV cache update path. Fix options:
- patch runtime to check allocator returns and short-circuit kv cache access (fast)
- revert pooling change and add more tests for fragmentation scenarios (thorough)

os h (SRE): Blocking v1.20.0 from future deploys via DeployGuard: `block image runtime:v1.20.0`

tessa (Product): Drafted longer note for status page and enterprise emails. ETA 25m to final customer message with root cause high-level info and credits offer.

sam (Support): Creating tickets per customer with request IDs and sample traces. Asking for retention extension for logs.

pagerbot: Incident state set to PARTIALLY_MITIGATED. Please file postmortem within 72 hours.

priya (ML Eng): I'll own the root cause PR and tests. Expected SLAs impact estimate: ~720k tokens affected; ~14 enterprise customers touched.

os h (SRE): Handoff note: I'm staying on for next 45m. Maria, enjoy the break.

maria (Oncall Eng): Leaving thread. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

pagerbot: Final note: error rate back near baseline after mitigations and rollback. Keep incident open until postmortem created.
